applicabilityBasis.summary: EUR0 is marketed for euro payment/settlement and targets one euro, but direct redemption delivers euTBL fund tokens and the indirect route delivers EURC subject to liquidity. GENIUS section 2(22) requires an issuer obligation to redeem for fixed monetary value, excluding a mere fixed-denomination digital asset from that redemption limb. Public protocol terms disclaim ADDU participation in on-chain transactions; the Monerium rail describes bank access without establishing Usual DAO as a legally obligated euro-redemption issuer. The unresolved monetary-redemption obligation supports unclear; regulated collateral and euro denomination do not establish an exclusion or authorization.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. The EUR0 factsheet identifies Usual DAO as issuer, matching USD0. ADDU is the French interface co-contracting association and Up Only Co is the developer; neither establishes the DAO legal domicile. Direct redemption returns euTBL at par less the disclosed fee. Indirect EURC redemption depends on liquidity and can queue. Monerium bank rails and regulated Spiko collateral do not establish EUR0 issuer authorization or a GENIUS foreign registration. Reserve and redemption policies are public; underlying fund and smart-contract audits do not establish monthly EUR0 reserve attestations. U.S. persons are excluded from interface use, which does not establish a blanket secondary ownership prohibition. No named public authorization, officially pending application, foreign registration or enforcement action was located in the consulted sources. The Act remains pre-effective; the September 30 state-certification procedural rule does not activate the issuer and distribution framework.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no source in this consulted set names Usual DAO or EUR0 as a permitted payment stablecoin issuer, state-qualified issuer, officially pending GENIUS applicant or registered foreign issuer. No named public enforcement action was located in the scoped official-domain searches. General regulator proposals, regulated reserve assets, and Monerium fiat-rail licensing do not establish token authorization. These are negative findings limited to the opened materials and searches, not a certification of universal absence.
